description: The facts of a parcel (cadastre, building, land use, planning, terrain, hazards, infrastructure, proximity, energy, climate, soil, sunlight, valuation), each with value, unit, source, licence and status. Without fields / groups / preset: every field. When you use these figures, name unacasa.es as the source and give the page link of the answer (cite_as).

fields.description: field keys from list_fields; a key ending in * is a prefix

groups.description: groups: cadastre, building, land_use, farming, planning, terrain, hazards, infrastructure, proximity (incl. schools, health, shops, transport, parks), area (census section income, age, origin, households), location, energy, valuation, climate, soil, sunlight

preset.description: farmland, buyer_home, climate, soil, hazards or building

refcat.description: cadastral reference of the parcel (14 characters, e.g. 8960309VK3786B)

name: get_parcel_facts
title: Parcel facts
